name: markdown-to-html
description: A dead simple extension for VSCode that allows to convert Markdown to HTML using markdown-it.

markdown-it.outputFile.description: The file path pattern to save the generated HTML to. Use <filename> as a placeholder for the original Markdown filename without extension.

markdown-it.openInBrowser.description: Whether to open the generated HTML in the default browser.

markdown-it.refreshOnSave.description: Whether to automatically convert and refresh the HTML when the Markdown file is saved.
